title: Chinese People Don't Know Star Wars?
synopsis: Star Wars is not as well known in China as in many other countries. In this lesson we learn how Disney has done its utmost to promote Star Wars: The Force Awakens in China.

fullText.simplified:
中国人不知道《星战》？

    虽然《星球大战：原力觉醒》已经在美国等地方上映了，但是在中国的上映时间是2016年1月9日。中国成了这部电影唯一还没有“征服”的大市场，这部电影在中国能否像其他国家那样受欢迎，成了迪士尼和好莱坞最关心的话题。
    其实在中国，还有很多年轻人不知道《星战》。因为《星战》已经有10年没有新片了。而中国从2009年开始电影市场才慢慢变好，那时候既没有新的《星战》，最后一部《星战》也已经过去了4年。
     为此，迪士尼在中国做了很多的宣传。比如，2015年10月，500个“风暴兵”登上了长城，整面墙都是“风暴兵”，4个烽火台分别挂着“原力觉醒”4个汉字，非常壮观。还有12月27日，迪士尼在上海市中心的大楼上点亮了两支“光剑”，从很远的地方都能看到。而且迪士尼在宣传中也没有特意强调新的《星战》和前面6部的联系，以免“吓跑”那些没有看过《星战》，怕看不懂的中国观众。
fullText.traditional:
中國人不知道《星戰》？

    雖然《星球大戰：原力覺醒》已經在美國等地方上映了，但是在中國的上映時間是2016年1月9日。中國成了這部電影唯一還沒有“征服”的大市場，這部電影在中國能否像其他國家那樣受歡迎，成了迪士尼和好萊塢最關心的話題。
    其實在中國，還有很多年輕人不知道《星戰》。因為《星戰》已經有10年沒有新片了。而中國從2009年開始電影市場才慢慢變好，那時候既沒有新的《星戰》，最後一部《星戰》也已經過去了4年。
     為此，迪士尼在中國做了很多的宣傳。比如，2015年10月，500個“風暴兵”登上了長城，整面牆都是“風暴兵”，4個烽火臺分別掛著“原力覺醒”4個漢字，非常壯觀。還有12月27日，迪士尼在上海市中心的大樓上點亮了兩支“光劍”，從很遠的地方都能看到。而且迪士尼在宣傳中也沒有特意強調新的《星戰》和前面6部的聯繫，以免“嚇跑”那些沒有看過《星戰》，怕看不懂的中國觀眾。

raw.synopsis: Star Wars is not as well known in China as in many other countries. In this lesson we learn how Disney has done its utmost to promote Star Wars: The Force Awakens in China.
sentence_translations: Chinese people don't know Star Wars?
Even though "Star Wars: The Force Awakens" has already premiered in the US and other countries, ..
.. in China it premieres on the 9th of January, 2016.
China has become the only large market which has yet to be conquered by this movie.
Whether the movie can become as popular in China as in other countries, is a topic of great interest for Disney and Hollywood.
In China, there are actually still a lot of young people who do not know what Star Wars is.
Because 10 years have already passed since the latest Star Wars movie.
The market for movies in China slowly started getting better first in 2009, ..
.. but not only was there not a new Star Wars out at that time, 4 years had also passed since the latest Star Wars.
Because of this, Disney has done a lot of marketing in China.
In October 2015 for example, 500 storm troopers climbed upon the Great Wall, and stormtroopers covered the entire wall.
On four watchtowers, the four characters for "The Force Awakens" were separately hung up in a spectacular fashion.
And on the 27th of December, Disney lit up two lightsabers on a large build in Shanghai which could be seen from far away.
Moreover, Disney intentionally have not emphasized the connection between the new Star Wars the previous 6 films in their marketing, ..
.. in order not to scare away those of the Chinese audience who have not seen Star Wars out of fear of not understanding.
